Fulbright Nehru Academic and Professional Excellence Fellowships 2027-278is an opportunity offered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) to Ph.D.or master's degree holders. This fellowship aims to provide an opportunity to Indian faculty, researchers and professionals to teach, conduct research or carry out a combination of teaching and research at an institution in the U.S. The selected fellows will receive a monthly stipend and other benefits.
To be eligible for the fellowship, an applicant must:-
have a Ph.D. degree with at least five years of relevant teaching/research/professional experience
have a master’s degree with at least five years of relevant experience

Employees of the Government of India and Indian State Governments are not eligible for any Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships. This includes civil servants in central services (such as IAS, IPS, IRS, IFS, and allied services), state government services (including state civil services), and bureaucratic staff employed in central and state ministries or departments.
The following benefits will be received by the selected fellows -
Accident and program exchanges as per the U.S. government guidelines

Subject to availability of funds, in case of grantees on eight or nine-month grants, a dependent allowance and international travel will be provided for one accompanying eligible dependent, provided the dependent is with the grantee in the U.S. for at least 80 per cent of the grant period.
Employer’s endorsement on the FNAPE Letter of Support from the Home Institution (if employed)
The applicant must upload a recent significant publication (copy of paper/article) in the online application (not exceeding 30 pages).

The candidates will be selected based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
The applicant can apply for only 1 Fulbright-Nehru fellowship category during a competition cycle.
Plagiarism in the application will lead to disqualification.
Unless otherwise specified, Fulbright-Nehru applications are to be submitted online.
Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.
Extensions and transfers of visa sponsorship will not be permitted.

The applicants will be affiliated to one U.S. host institution for their grant. USIEF strongly recommends all applicants to identify institutions with which they wish to be affiliated and to correspond, in advance, with potential host institutions.
If the applicants have secured a letter of invitation from a U.S. institution, they need to include it as a part of their online application.
A maximum of two round-trip economy class air tickets for the grantee only will be provided (one ticket per trip).
The minimum length of the total grant is four months and the maximum is six months.
The grant must have two segments.
The minimum length for any grant segment is one month and the maximum is three months.
Applicants may propose a one-month segment only once.

Indian academics and professionals contribute to the internationalization of the curriculum at their U.S. host institutions and the understanding of recent developments not just in India but globally.
The recipient will be affiliated as a visiting scholar at a U.S. institution and will teach courses individually or team-teach.
The applicant should upload a recent significant publication (copy of paper/article) in the online application.

If the applicants are employed, they must follow the instructions carefully regarding the employer’s endorsement. The employer must indicate that leave will be granted for the fellowship period. The applicant must obtain the endorsement from the appropriate administrative authority on the Letter of Support from the Home Institution.
Question: What is the last date to apply for the Fulbright Nehru Academic and Professional Excellence Fellowship?
The last date to apply for this scheme is 01st July 2026.
Question: Who is offering this opportunity?
This fellowship is being offered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF).
Question: Can Indian students apply for this scheme?
Yes, Indian students can apply for this fellowship.
Question: Who can apply for this fellowship?
Ph.D. or master's degree holders can apply for this fellowship.
Question: Will fellows receive air tickets?
Yes, the selected fellows will receive round-trip economy class travel.
